title: healpix-resample: PSF-aware resampling tools for HEALPix Earth-observation grids
description:
A lightweight, GPU-friendly Python package for regridding data from unstructured longitude/latitude samples onto a HEALPix grid. Every resampler builds a sparse PyTorch operator mapping input samples to a subset of HEALPix cells at a chosen resolution level, so the same forward/inverse operator can be reused, batched, and run on CPU or CUDA.

The PSFResampler treats projected-grid pixels as sparse, spatially weighted measurements of an unknown HEALPix field and recovers that field through a matrix-free weighted least-squares problem, jointly accounting for the sensor point spread function and the source-to-HEALPix geometry. Nearest-neighbour, bilinear, bicubic, conservative, group-by and cell-point resamplers share the same API.

Part of the GRID4EARTH open-source HEALPix tool stack, alongside healpix-geo, healpix-analyse and healpix-plot.
